shared_elements: repeated abstract signs or glyph-like motifs
linear relief-style outlines with interior detailing
justification: The strongest shared content is the presence of profile bird-like imagery together with repeated sign-like motifs arranged in bands or panels. The major difference is that B is dominated by a single elaborate standing profile figure with a feathered headdress and surrounding glyph blocks, whereas A is a more schematic register of animals and simple geometric patterns with no comparable central human scene.
